type_specific_options.meaning: Salary formulas and conditions may refer to assigned base salary, named salary components, employee attributes, and salary-statement values such as payment days and leave without pay. Example: when base salary is below ten thousand, a component equals base salary multiplied by 0.2. A second component may equal ten percent of basic salary when basic salary exceeds two thousand. A fixed one-thousand amount may be selected for internship employment. Component dependencies must be resolved before dependent formulas are evaluated.
